column_description: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each panel record.
UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), linking this panel to a specific plant.
VARCHAR(100) describing the manufacturer’s name (was 'PanelManufacturer'). Possible enumerations: 'Longi', 'Canadian Solar', 'JA Solar', 'JinkoSolar', 'Trina'.
VARCHAR(100) capturing the panel’s model line or series (was 'PanelModel') (e.g., 'ModelX', 'CS6K-P').
VARCHAR(50) labeling the panel type (was 'PanelType'). Possible enumerations: 'Mono-PERC', 'HJT', 'Poly-PERC', 'Bifacial', 'TOPCon'.
SMALLINT specifying the rated power output of the panel in watts (was 'PanelRatedPowerW'). Possible enumerations: 650, 450, 600, 550, 500.
DECIMAL(7,3) storing the panel’s nominal efficiency percentage (was 'PanelEfficiencyPercent') (e.g., 21.345).
NUMERIC(7,3) indicating the panel’s nominal operating temperature in °C (was 'NominalOperatingTempC') (e.g., 45.000).
DECIMAL(4,3) capturing the temperature coefficient for panel performance (was 'TemperatureCoefficient') (e.g., -0.350).
